apps.name: Shopify Search & Discovery
apps.type: Shopify's own search, filter & recommendations app
apps.summary: Shopify's free app for customising storefront search: filters, synonyms, product boosts, related/complementary product recommendations and search analytics. Semantic (AI) understanding is built into Shopify's online store search.
apps.ai_billing: No usage fee. The app is free. Shopify says semantic understanding is included in online store search, so there's nothing extra to switch on or pay for in the app. Your Shopify plan itself is a separate cost.
apps.ai_short: Free app; semantic search built into Shopify search

plans.name: Free
plans.includes: Filters, synonyms, product boosts, related & complementary recommendations, search analytics

apps.notes: Rated 2.6/5 (511 reviews) on the Shopify App Store when checked. Merchants with big catalogs or heavy merchandising needs often outgrow it, which is why the paid apps below exist.

apps.name: Searchanise Search & Filter
apps.summary: Search and filter app priced purely by the number of products in your catalog. Every paid plan has the same core features (AI personalization, filters, recommendations); bigger plans add support hours and a dedicated server.
apps.ai_billing: No per-search or per-session fees. You pay a flat monthly price set by how many active, searchable products you have (Free up to 25, then 1.5k, 7.5k, 15k, 30k, 50k and 300k product tiers). Personalized AI search is included on every paid plan.
apps.ai_short: Flat fee by product count; unlimited searches

plans.name: Essential
plans.includes: Up to 7,500 products; label removed, banners

plans.name: Premium
plans.includes: Up to 300,000 products; dedicated server, calls

apps.free_alt: Shopify Search & Discovery (free) covers basic filters, synonyms and boosts.
apps.notes: Annual billing saves up to 17% (e.g. Essential $396/yr = $33/mo).

apps.name: Boost AI Search & Discovery
apps.summary: One of the biggest Shopify search & filter apps. Since October 2025 new installs are priced by your store's monthly GMV (gross sales), not product count, across three packages: Launch, Convert and Accelerate.
apps.ai_billing: Monthly subscription set by your 'Base GMV' (average gross sales over the last 3 months), plus an overage of $2 per $1,000 of GMV above your plan's limit (capped). AI search, synonyms and semantic search are included; AI personalization is on Accelerate.
apps.ai_short: Monthly fee by store GMV (sales), + $2 per $1k GMV over limit

plans.name: Launch
plans.includes: From $29/mo; Boost's site shows $29 for up to $50K monthly GMV

plans.name: Convert
plans.includes: Boost's site shows $239 for up to $100K GMV; Boost's help centre example shows Convert at $299 for a $100K limit

plans.name: Accelerate
plans.includes: Boost's site shows $399 for up to $650K GMV; help centre example shows an Accelerate tier at $699

msgs: Launch: Boost's pricing page shows $29/mo for up to $50K monthly GMV, so a $15K-GMV store should land here. Boost assigns the exact sub-tier from your order data, and its Shopify listing describes Launch as 'from $29', so confirm in-app.

Convert tier for ~$75K GMV: Boost's pricing page shows $239/mo (up to $100K GMV) while its help centre example shows $299/mo for a $100K limit. Conflicting official figures, so not public / check site.
~$300K GMV: Boost's pricing page shows Accelerate $399/mo up to $650K GMV, while its help centre shows Accelerate tiers from $699. Not public / check site.

apps.free_alt: Shopify Search & Discovery (free) covers basic filters, synonyms and boosts.
unconfirmed: Exact GMV sub-tier prices: Boost's pricing page and help centre show different figures for the Convert and Accelerate packages
When we checked from our location, the Shopify App Store page showed 'not currently available'. It may be regional; check the listing yourself
apps.notes: Merchants who installed before October 2025 stay on legacy, product-count pricing.

apps.name: Fast Simon AI Search & Filters
apps.summary: AI search and collection merchandising app priced by monthly sessions, meaning every store visit, not just visits that use search. Paid plans support up to 40,000 products.
apps.ai_billing: Flat monthly plans capped by monthly sessions: 100 (free), 2,000, 10,000 and 30,000. Above 30,000 sessions you need a custom/Enterprise quote. AI multimodal search is on Top Pro.
apps.ai_short: Flat fee by monthly sessions (all store visits)

plans.name: Top Pro
plans.includes: 30,000 monthly sessions, merchandising rules, A/B tests, AI multimodal search

apps.free_alt: Shopify Search & Discovery (free) covers basic filters, synonyms and boosts.
unconfirmed: Prices above 30,000 monthly sessions (Enterprise) are not public
apps.notes: A third-party review (motive.co) reports that a Fast Simon session is every store visit, whether or not the shopper searches; Fast Simon's own listing just says 'Monthly Sessions'. Annual prices: $399.96/$999.96/$2,999.88 a year.

apps.name: Doofinder
apps.summary: Site search with recommendations and a quiz builder in every plan. Shopify prices are higher than Doofinder's general web prices, and plans are capped by monthly requests per product (search, recommendations, quiz).
apps.ai_billing: Flat monthly plans capped by requests per month. A request is counted whenever Doofinder's server responds, and search-as-you-type counts from the third keystroke. Doofinder lists caps of 10k (Basic), 150k (Pro) and 400k (Advanced) requests per product.
apps.ai_short: Flat fee by monthly search requests (keystroke-level)

plans.name: Basic
plans.includes: AI guided search, custom results, recommendations, quiz maker; up to 10k requests/mo per product

plans.name: Pro
plans.includes: AI alerts, multi-index, search suggestions; up to 150k requests/mo

plans.name: Advanced
plans.includes: 1:1 personalization, visual search; up to 400k requests/mo

apps.free_alt: Shopify Search & Discovery (free) covers basic filters, synonyms and boosts.
unconfirmed: Request caps come from doofinder.com's general pricing page; the Shopify listing doesn't state them, so we assume they apply to the Shopify plans too
apps.notes: On doofinder.com the general (non-Shopify) prices are $49/$149/$349 a month. The Shopify App Store prices ($61/$186/$436) are used here. Annual: $661.44/$2,011.44/$4,711.44 a year.

apps.name: Algolia
apps.summary: Developer-first search API used by large brands. The pay-as-you-go plans are very cheap at low volume, but you or a developer must build and maintain the Shopify integration.
apps.ai_billing: Pay as you go. Grow Plus (keyword search plus AI ranking, AI synonyms and personalization) includes 10K search requests/month, then charges $1.75 per extra 1K. Plain keyword Grow is $0.50 per extra 1K. 100K records are included on both, then $0.40 per 1K. Search-as-you-type counts every keystroke as a request.

plans.name: Grow
plans.includes: $0 base; 10K requests incl., then $0.50/1K; 100K records incl., then $0.40/1K

plans.name: Grow Plus
plans.includes: $0 base; 10K requests incl., then $1.75/1K; AI ranking, AI synonyms, personalization

apps.free_alt: Shopify Search & Discovery (free) covers basic filters, synonyms and boosts.
unconfirmed: Elevate (NeuralSearch, the full AI search) pricing is custom/annual
apps.notes: The estimate covers search requests only. Recommendations (10K/mo included, then $0.60 per 1K), developer time and any Shopify connector costs aren't included. Records: each product variant or pre-sorted replica can count as a record.

apps.name: Wiser AI Upsell & Cross Sell
apps.summary: AI product recommendations, frequently-bought-together, cart drawer and post-purchase upsells, priced by your total monthly store orders. AI search (IntelliSearch) is only on the Enterprise plan.
apps.ai_billing: Flat monthly fee set automatically by your store's total orders that month: free to 50, $9 to 100, $19 to 300, $49 to 500, $99 to 1,000, $199 to 2,000. Above 2,000 orders is an Enterprise quote.
apps.ai_short: Flat fee by monthly store orders
apps.free_alt: Shopify Search & Discovery (free) adds related and complementary product recommendations.
unconfirmed: Enterprise pricing (over 2,000 orders/month) is not public
apps.notes: All orders in your store admin count toward the plan, not just orders Wiser influenced.

apps.name: LimeSpot AI Bundles & Upsells
apps.summary: AI recommendations, bundles and upsells. Turbo is priced by orders and isn't available on Shopify Plus. Max (segmentation, A/B tests, email/SMS personalization) is priced by Online Store revenue.
apps.ai_billing: Turbo starts at $9.99/mo and rises with orders (LimeSpot's example: up to 250 orders = $19.99); it's free for up to 10 orders. Max is priced by Online Store revenue per 30 days: $50 up to $15K, $75 up to $25K, $150 up to $50K, $225 up to $75K, $300 up to $100K, $375 up to $200K, $525 up to $400K, and so on up to $3,200 for $5M.
apps.ai_short: Turbo by orders; Max by revenue ($50–$3,200/mo)

plans.name: Turbo Free
plans.includes: Up to 10 orders/mo; not for Shopify Plus

plans.name: Turbo
plans.includes: From $9.99; up to 250 orders = $19.99; higher order tiers not public

plans.name: Max
plans.includes: From $50 (up to $15K revenue/30 days); $150 at $50K; $525 at $400K; $1,500 at $2M

apps.free_alt: Shopify Search & Discovery (free) adds related and complementary product recommendations.
unconfirmed: Turbo prices above 250 orders/month are not public, so medium and large stores are priced on Max (Turbo may be cheaper)
apps.notes: Max revenue tiers are read from the slider on LimeSpot's official pricing page.

apps.name: Rebuy Personalization Engine
apps.type: AI personalization, smart cart, search & upsells
apps.summary: Popular personalization suite (smart cart, upsells, bundles, Smart Search) sold as à-la-carte packages, each priced by your monthly Shopify orders, or as the all-in-one Platform One.
apps.ai_billing: Each package (Cart & Merchandising, Checkout & Post Purchase, Search & Collections, Flows & A/B Testing) is priced by orders per month, from $25/mo for one package. Bundling saves 10% on two, 20% on three and 30% on four. Premium support is $499/mo. Rebuy bills on a 30-day cycle based on the previous 30 days' orders.
apps.ai_short: Per package, priced by monthly orders (from $25)

plans.name: Rebuy Monetize
plans.includes: Free; pays you for post-purchase partner offers

plans.name: Build your own (per package)
plans.includes: From $25/mo per package; per-order tiers not public

plans.name: Platform One
plans.includes: All packages; Rebuy's page shows $534/mo billed monthly (order volume for that figure not stated)

msgs: Rebuy prices each package by orders per month but doesn't publish the order tiers. Lowest published price: $25/mo for one package.
Order-based tiers not public. Talk to Rebuy's sales team or check the in-app estimate.
Order-based tiers not public. Platform One is shown at $534/mo, but the order volume behind that figure isn't stated.

apps.free_alt: Shopify Search & Discovery (free) adds basic related-product recommendations.
unconfirmed: Order-based package tiers are not public (the page shows placeholders until you pick a volume)
When we checked from our location, the Shopify App Store page showed 'not currently available'. It may be regional; check the listing yourself
apps.notes: Existing customers aren't automatically moved to package pricing.

apps.name: Klevu / Searchspring (Athos Commerce)
apps.summary: Klevu and Searchspring are now part of Athos Commerce. The Shopify app is free to install, but the AI search, merchandising and recommendations are sold as annual Athos plans on a custom quote.
apps.ai_billing: Custom quote. Athos sells Onsite Discovery (AI search, merchandising, recommendations, bundling) as annual plans and bills separately from your Shopify invoice.

plans.name: Shopify app
plans.includes: Free to install; an Athos plan is required

msgs: Not public. Athos Commerce quotes every plan.
Not public. Athos Commerce quotes every plan.
Not public. Athos Commerce quotes every plan.

apps.free_alt: Shopify Search & Discovery (free) covers basic filters, synonyms and boosts.
apps.notes: Searchspring is also part of Athos Commerce, so its pricing is quote-only too.

apps.name: Nosto AI Search & Discovery
apps.summary: Modular commerce experience platform (personalized search, category merchandising, recommendations, bundles, pop-ups, UGC). The Shopify app is free to install, but a paid Nosto account is required.
apps.ai_billing: Custom quote: a base platform fee plus a fixed fee based on your GMV turnover and traffic, and the modules you choose. AI is included in every module. There's no self-serve free trial, only a proof of concept for qualified merchants.
apps.ai_short: Custom quote by GMV, traffic & modules

plans.name: Shopify app
plans.includes: Free to install; a Nosto account is required and isn't free

plans.name: Modular plan
plans.includes: Base platform fee + volume-based fee; custom quote

msgs: Not public. Nosto quotes by GMV, traffic and modules.
Not public. Nosto quotes by GMV, traffic and modules.
Not public. Nosto quotes by GMV, traffic and modules.

apps.free_alt: Shopify Search & Discovery (free) covers basic filters, synonyms, boosts and recommendations.
